rationale: The telemetry indicates significant issues with line loss and control effort, with a maximum error of 0.064961 and control effort of 0.850416. To improve stability and reduce line loss, I increased the wheel track to 0.18, adjusted the sensor positions for better distribution, and lowered the kp value to 0.8 to reduce overshooting. These changes should enhance the robot's ability to follow the line more effectively and reduce stalling, leading to improved performance in future trials.
